# BlockVote — local & production environment variables
# Copy to Voting/.env and fill in values.

# ── Database (required locally) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
MONGODB_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/blockvote

# ── Auth (required) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
JWT_SECRET=change-me-in-production
SERVER_IDENTITY_SECRET=change-me-in-production
AUTH_SECRET=change-me-in-production

# ── Blockchain ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8545
NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=
RELAYER_PRIVATE_KEY=
GAS_STATION_PRIVATE_KEY=

# ── Image storage — party symbols & candidate photos ──────────────────────────
# Create an IAM user with s3:PutObject + s3:GetObject on your bucket.
# Images are served via GET /api/assets/... (authenticated proxy) — public bucket NOT required.
#
# Required for dashboard symbol/photo uploads (POST /api/uploads):
AWS_REGION=ap-south-1
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
AWS_S3_BUCKET=blockvotingdev
#
# Used to build absolute proxy URLs returned from uploads and stored on-chain:
#   https://your-domain.com/api/assets/party-symbols/<org>/<file>.png
# (Set NEXTAUTH_URL in the Vercel / production section below.)
#
# Optional: legacy direct S3 URLs (not needed when using the asset proxy).
# AWS_S3_PUBLIC_URL=https://blockvotingdev.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com

# ── Face verification (biometric twin detection) ─────────────────────────────
# Uses the same AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY / AWS_REGION when set.
# IAM also needs rekognition:DetectFaces, CompareFaces, IndexFaces, SearchFacesByImage.

# ── Email (Resend) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RESEND_API_KEY=
RESEND_FROM_EMAIL=noreply@yourdomain.com

# ── IPFS (Pinata — optional metadata pinning) ───────────────────────────────
PINATA_JWT=
PINATA_GATEWAY=https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs/

# ── ImageKit (legacy photo CDN — optional if using S3 for all uploads) ────────
IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY=
IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY=
IMAGEKIT_URL_ENDPOINT=

# ── Guardian addresses (Sepolia / production) ─────────────────────────────────
NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_1=
NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_2=
NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_3=

# ── Vercel / production URL ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3000

version: '3.8'

services:
  # ── MongoDB ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  mongodb:
    image: mongo:7.0
    container_name: blockvote-mongodb
    ports:
      - '27017:27017'
    volumes:
      - mongodb_data:/data/db
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "--eval", "db.adminCommand('ping')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  # ── Hardhat Local Blockchain ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  blockchain:
    image: node:20-alpine
    container_name: blockvote-chain
    working_dir: /app
    volumes:
      - .:/app
      - chain_modules:/app/node_modules
    ports:
      - '8545:8545'
    command: >
      sh -c "yarn install --frozen-lockfile && npx hardhat node --hostname 0.0.0.0"
    restart: unless-stopped

  # ── Next.js App (development mode) ─────────────────────────────────────────
  app:
    image: node:20-alpine
    container_name: blockvote-app
    working_dir: /app
    volumes:
      - .:/app
      - app_modules:/app/node_modules
    ports:
      - '3000:3000'
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      - MONGODB_URI=mongodb://mongodb:27017/blockvote
      - RPC_URL=http://blockchain:8545
      - NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL=http://localhost:8545
    depends_on:
      mongodb:
        condition: service_healthy
      blockchain:
        condition: service_started
    command: >
      sh -c "yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn dev"
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  mongodb_data:
    driver: local
  chain_modules:
    driver: local
  app_modules:
    driver: local

# ─── Stage 1: Dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app

# Install yarn if not already present
RUN corepack enable && corepack prepare yarn@1.22.22 --activate

# Copy package manifests
COPY package.json yarn.lock ./

# Install production dependencies only
RUN yarn install --frozen-lockfile --production=false

# ─── Stage 2: Build ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .

# Build Next.js production bundle
# Note: Build-time env vars for NEXT_PUBLIC_* must be set here
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_1
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_2
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_3
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS

ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS=$NEXT_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_ADDRESS
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_RPC_URL
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_1=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_1
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_2=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_2
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_3=$NEXT_PUBLIC_GUARDIAN_3
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS=$NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS

RUN yarn build

# ─── Stage 3: Production Runtime ────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1

# Create non-root user for security
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 nodejs && \
    adduser --system --uid 1001 nextjs

# Copy only what's needed for production
COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY --from=builder /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=builder /app/.next/static ./.next/static

# Copy contract ABIs (needed by relay at runtime)
COPY --from=builder /app/lib/contracts ./lib/contracts

USER nextjs

EXPOSE 3000
ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0"

CMD ["node", "server.js"]
